trello.name: Sign venue contract with AV recording
trello.desc: Owner: Diego. Get the convention center contract (main hall plus two breakout rooms, $18,000, catering separate) through legal review and signed by end of next week. Confirm in writing that the AV package includes recording in all three rooms, not just the main hall. Acceptance criteria: fully executed contract with recording coverage documented for all three rooms.

trello.name: Lock speaker lineup within two weeks
trello.desc: Owner: Bo. Send final follow-ups to the two maybe speakers with a decision deadline of Friday. Use the backup list of five names to fill any slots that fall through, ensuring the third slot is filled. Commitment: have the full lineup of nine speakers locked in within two weeks so the agenda can be printed.

trello.name: Obtain keynote abstract from Dr. Osei
trello.desc: Owner: Bo. Chase Dr. Osei for the keynote abstract this week. The abstract is needed for the website and the printed program. Acceptance criteria: keynote abstract received and ready for use in marketing materials.

trello.name: Draft and send three-wave email campaign
trello.desc: Owner: Diego. Draft all three email campaign waves this month: (1) agenda announcement when Bo locks the lineup, (2) early-bird deadline reminder two weeks before the price change, (3) final-week push. First wave goes out the day the agenda is live. Acceptance criteria: all three drafts completed this month and waves sent on schedule to drive registration toward the 600 target.

trello.name: Same-day handoff of speaker bios and headshots
trello.desc: Owner: Bo. Once the speaker lineup locks, immediately hand the speaker bios and headshots straight to Diego on the same day for the landing page update. Do not sit on them. Acceptance criteria: Diego receives complete bios and headshots the same day the lineup locks so speaker pages can be live before email wave one.

trello.name: Update website speaker pages before wave one
trello.desc: Owner: Diego. Using bios and headshots received from Bo, update the website speaker pages so they are live before the first email campaign wave goes out. Acceptance criteria: speaker pages published on the website prior to the agenda announcement email.

trello.name: Review and approve swag design proofs
trello.desc: Owner: Camille. Review the swag design proofs located in the shared drive today. Once approved, Diego will place the order this week. Acceptance criteria: design proofs approved (or rejected with feedback) today so the order can proceed promptly given the six-week lead time.

trello.name: Place swag order after proof approval
trello.desc: Owner: Diego. Once Camille approves the design proofs, place the swag order this week. Order contents: 800 shirts across sizes, 500 notebooks, 1,000 stickers, totaling approximately $9,200 including rush buffer. Acceptance criteria: order placed this week to account for the six-week lead time.
